verdict.rationale: Moneybird documents a REST API that the MCP server and CLI also run on. It covers contacts (create, update, get, duplicates, filtering) and subscription management, so meaningful UI functionality is exposed programmatically. There is no documented claim or proof of full UI parity. UI features like hour tracking, quotes, tax submission and payment pages are not shown as API endpoints, and no OpenAPI spec was found to confirm coverage. Missing for 10: explicit API–UI parity statement, documented endpoints for UI features like quotes, time tracking and tax filing, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use the following endpoints to get information about contacts, create new contacts or update existing contacts.
Three channels on the same REST API: MCP for an AI chat, the CLI for the terminal, the API for your own software.
